target: forge.sh kind — notgitlab hosts and gitlab only in the path do not match the gitlab rule
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://example.test/o/r.git
k() { fx_setremote "$2"; fx_run kind; echo "$1=$FX_OUT"; }
k notgitlab https://notgitlab.example.test/o/r.git
k midlabel https://my-gitlab.example.test/o/r.git
k subnot https://ci.notgitlab.example.test/o/r.git
k pathonly https://example.test/gitlab/r.git
k githubpath https://github.com/gitlab/gitlab.git
fx_done
